text:
maya: Quick design review on the rollout list and timeline scrubber. Noticed two usability issues on staging: tiny delta chips overlap on narrow screens, and the A/B label 'variant A / variant B' is ambiguous when you pin a version.

ezra: Can you blame a screenshot? sounds like the chip is absolutely positioned and doesn't wrap.

maya: yep, screenshot in thread: /s/rollout/timeline-narrow. When you compress to mobile width the delta chip gets clipped. also the A/B label reads 'A/B' only 12; that's not helpful in audit logs.

toni: accessibility note: audit logs should read full names like 'Experiment: checkout flow - Variant A (50%)'. we shouldn't rely on single-letter labels for SR.

olga: SR copy suggestion: "Experiment checkout flow. Variant A: controls 50 percent. Variant B: new layout, controls 50 percent." set with aria-live="polite" for live changes.

ezra: UI idea: move delta out of the pill into a trailing microchip that can wrap beneath the variant name on small widths. maintain a compact icon for active variant.

maya: +1. Also propose we change A/B to 'Control / Variant' in the UI and in the timeline node. that reads better for non-engineers in support.

toni: keyboard navigation problem: when tabbing through timeline nodes, the focus skips past the microchip. need to consolidate the node into a single focusable element with internal controls reachable via arrow keys.

olga: for focus-visible we should add visible focus ring and add aria-describedby pointing to the delta text so SR users get both pieces.

ezra: copy question: confirm modal for "Promote variant" currently says 'Promote'. Should it be 'Promote to 100% (replace others)'? we had a support issue where people thought promote meant create new canary.

maya: let's be explicit. long label for modal heading: 'Promote Variant B to all traffic' and primary button 'Promote to 100%'. secondary 'Cancel'. include keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Enter to confirm.

toni: timeline scrubber motion: the hover translate feels fine on desktop but jerks on lower-fps devices. add prefers-reduced-motion and a CSS transition fallback.

ezra: engineering ask: if we change chips to microchips that wrap, give us the component token names and the max-width breakpoints. we'll prototype in the component library.

olga: SR debounce policy: for live allocation changes, batch updates that happen within 800ms into one aria announcement to avoid noise. also include explicit messages for removal: 'Variant B removed from experiment'.

maya: design-bot ACTIONS: maya to upload two mocks (wrap microchip and trailing microchip) + responsive specs; olga to draft SR strings; ezra to add token list; toni to spec keyboard interactions. Due: Tue EOD. :spiral_note_pad: 

ezra: I'll include token names like --chip-min-width, --chip-gap, --chip-breakpoint-sm and an example tailwind class list.

maya: will also include copy variants for the audit log entries and an example timeline node markup snippet.

toni: one more tiny nit: in version history timeline, the 'undo' icon is visually similar to 'expand'. maybe swap to a left-pointing arrow for undo and keep chevron for expand.

olga: agreed. ensure icon buttons have aria-labels like 'Undo to previous version' and 'Expand version details'.

maya: cool. I'll post mocks tomorrow morning and tag eng and support. thanks! :tada:
